verdict.rationale: Windmill is self-hostable via Docker/Docker Compose or Kubernetes Helm chart, which implicitly lets a user control where their data resides by deploying in any region/infrastructure of their choosing. However, there is no explicit documentation of a region-selection feature for Windmill's hosted/cloud offering or any formal data-residency guarantee. Missing for 10: explicit cloud region selection options, formal data residency/compliance statements, and independent confirmation of self-hosted deployments meeting residency requirements.
